name: print-social-pink-grid-paper-tech-talk-flyer-with-vr-headset
title: Tech career talk flyer on pink grid paper with a VR-headset portrait
whatItIs: A pale pink squared-paper flyer with a logo pill at top, a small ladies-in-tech tag, a huge 'How to Get Started in Tech' in black with 'Tech' in gradient blue, blue and pink info pills for venue and date, and a cut-out portrait of a woman wearing a white VR headset. Colourful chevron shapes peek from the sides.
whatItMeans: Fresh, energetic and inclusive; the headset gives a clear tech signal.
techniques: Use a soft pink grid background with multi-colour chevron accents.
Contrast heavy black title text with one gradient word.
Choose a cutout portrait holding a tech prop.

vocabulary.definition: One word with a colour gradient inside a headline.
A portrait with an object that signals the topic.
